summary: [video generation + reference generation] The target video is a 15-second high-intensity action sequence featuring a cross-era duel between <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>. The video emphasizes raw handheld camera aesthetics, anamorphic lens flares, and rapid rhythmic editing. The fight dynamically shifts between <Scene 1> and <Scene 2> using match-cut transitions based on movement vectors, creating a seamless spatial disorientation effect.

retention_analysis: <Subject 1>: fully_preserved - Costume details (grey robe, white gauze), sword, and hairstyle remain consistent.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - Black tank top, tactical pants, and hand wraps remain consistent; sweat and dirt accumulation increases.
<Scene 1>: fully_preserved - Used in [Shot 1] and [Shot 3]; warm lighting and architectural details are maintained.
<Scene 2>: fully_preserved - Used in [Shot 2] and [Shot 4]; snow density and cold lighting are maintained.

detailed_description: The video is shot with a simulated handheld 35mm anamorphic lens, featuring slight focus hunting, horizontal lens flares, and organic camera shake. The rhythm is aggressive: slow tension, explosive speed, chaotic close-quarters, and a dramatic finish.

[Shot 1] The camera is static but breathing slightly, positioned at a low angle in <Scene 1> (the ancient inn). <Subject 1> (<Subject 1>) stands in the foreground, back to the camera, her hand resting on her sword hilt. The warm lantern light creates a strong rim light on her silhouette. At 00:01.5, she draws her sword with a swift motion. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, focusing on the steel blade reflecting the orange lantern light. The atmosphere is tense and quiet.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts abruptly to <Scene 2> (the snowy mountain). The camera whips pans right at extreme speed, following <Subject 2> (<Subject 2>) as he lunges forward with a powerful punch. The motion blur is heavy, obscuring details momentarily. As the camera stabilizes, we see <Subject 2>'s fist connecting with <Subject 1>'s sword blade (which she has raised to block). Snow explodes into the air from the impact. The lighting shifts instantly from warm orange to cold blue.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to a chaotic, shaky close-up in <Scene 1>. The camera shakes strongly to mimic the intensity of the fight. <Subject 1> (<Subject 1>) and <Subject 2> (<Subject 2>) are locked in a grapple. <Subject 1> pushes <Subject 2> away, her white gauze robes swirling around them. The camera tracks backward rapidly as they separate, keeping both in frame. Rain begins to fall in <Scene 1>, mixing with the sweat on <Subject 2>'s face. The focus shifts rapidly between their faces, capturing their intense expressions.

[Shot 4] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to <Scene 2>. The camera is now in a slow-motion arc shot (bullet time effect) around <Subject 1> (<Subject 1>) as she leaps into the air for a final strike. The background is the blurred, snowy peaks of <Scene 2>. <Subject 2> (<Subject 2>) is visible below, looking up, his hand raised to defend. The camera rotates counter-clockwise slowly, emphasizing the grace of <Subject 1>'s movement against the harsh environment. The anamorphic flare from the moon cuts horizontally across the frame.

[Shot 5] At 00:13.500, the camera cuts to a sudden, jarring close-up of the sword tip stopping inches from <Subject 2>'s eye. The camera shakes violently one last time, then freezes. The screen cuts to black.

No subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermarks, or typography appear anywhere in the video.

overall_soundscape: The soundscape is visceral and dynamic. [Shot 1] features the subtle sound of wind and the metallic *shing* of the sword being drawn. [Shot 2] introduces a loud, muffled *thud* of the punch-block impact and the crunch of snow. [Shot 3] is filled with the sounds of heavy breathing, fabric tearing, and rain hitting stone. [Shot 4] slows down the audio, emphasizing the whoosh of air and the heartbeat of the characters. The final cut is marked by a sharp, high-pitched ring that abruptly silences all other sounds.

non_diegetic_music: A percussive, rhythmic score drives the action. It starts with a low, sustained bass drone in [Shot 1]. As the cut to [Shot 2] happens, a sharp, aggressive taiko drum beat kicks in, syncing with the punch. In [Shot 3], the drums become faster and more chaotic, layered with distorted electric guitar screeches. In [Shot 4], the music drops out almost entirely, leaving only a haunting, high-pitched string note that builds tension until the final cut.
